sections.title: Three network rule checks
sections.what: Checks that assets filter by configuration and underground status, that terminals resolve by identity and not project name, and that activity keys keep their project.
sections.why: Likely reason: these rules prevent data from separate plans or projects being mixed up.

summary: Tests three rules: alternative configurations stay separate, endpoint lookup uses explicit ids only, and activity keys keep their project.
purpose: Protects the helper functions in networkTypes.ts from regressions.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the test names.
how: Runs three checks with small fake data. One checks that asset filtering follows configuration and underground status. One checks that terminals resolve by id and not by project name. One checks that activity keys differ across projects.
inputs: Small made-up network and station objects.
outputs: Pass or fail results from the test runner.
risks: The fake data may not match the real data shape, so the tests can pass while real data fails.
debug: If a test fails, compare the expected and actual lists it prints with the matching helper in networkTypes.ts.
